claims.claim: Teleoperation data and scene observations support training; keyframes guide hierarchical policy learning; visual states are represented in a compact latent space.

claims.scope: Reported keyframe extraction result, not a reduction in excavation time or energy.

claims.claim: Success increased from 40% to over 60% with action-bound visual representation versus a pure autoencoder.
claims.scope: The visual representation experiment, not field deployment performance.

claims.claim: Experiments used simulation and laboratory robotic arms.

referenceDecks.narrative: Teleoperation and demonstration → data/keyframe challenge → learning/goal challenge → framework → laboratory executions.

referenceDecks.visualReferenceUse: Art direction: large machinery photographs, landscape crops, industrial scale. Third-party stock artwork in these decks was not republished because its license was not supplied. No rental, pricing, company, or placeholder deck copy was reused.

applications.status: Proposed extensions; none presented as a completed application of the featured paper.
applications.interpretation: Demonstration learning is a possible starting point. Each new task requires new demonstrations, sensing, hardware/control adaptation, and validation; there is no claim of direct zero-shot transfer. Utility avoidance is an integration direction, not a proven collision-avoidance function.
